# LunarSight repository context

Read the repository-root `AGENTS.md`, then `docs/project-state.md`. Use `docs/README.md` to find task-relevant documents.

The current phase is documentation and agent-ready setup only. Do not introduce processing scripts, application code, package files, executable tests, CI jobs, downloaded datasets, or deployment manifests. A later explicit implementation request may change the authorized scope.
